VICTOIRE de LeBlanc

Baited Hook.tx: 1 energy and 1 order rune, exhaust: Kill a friendly unit. Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish a unit from among them that has Might up to 1 more than the killed unit and play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.

Akali, Rogue Assassin.tx: [Empower] 3 energy and 1 rune of any type (3 energy and 1 rune of any type: Empower this. Use only if not Empowered.) [Action][>] exhaust: If it's your turn, move a friendly unit in a showdown to base and if I'm [Empowered], ready it.

LeBlanc, Fragmented.tx: [Assault] (+1 might while I'm an attacker.) [Deathknell][>] Draw 1. If it's your Beginning Phase, draw 2 instead. (When I die, get the effect.)

Noxus Hopeful.tx: [Legion] — I cost 2 energy less. (Get the effect if you've played another card this turn.)

Block.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Give a unit [Shield 3] and [Tank] this turn. (+3 might while it's a defender. It must be assigned combat damage first.)

Rift Herald.tx: When I move to a battlefield, look at the top 3 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal a unit from among them and draw it. Recycle the rest. [Deathknell][>] Play a unit from your hand to your base, ignoring its Energy cost. (When I die, get the effect. You must still pay its Power cost.)

LeBlanc, Everywhere At Once.tx: [Backline] (I must be assigned combat damage last.) Your [Temporary] effects at my battlefield don't trigger.

Thousand-Tailed Watcher.tx: [Accelerate] (You may pay 1 energy and 1 mind rune as an additional cost to have me enter ready.) When you play me, give enemy units -3 might this turn, to a minimum of 1 might.

Harnessed Dragon.tx: When you play me, kill an enemy unit.

Astral Heron.tx: When you play your first card each turn, if I'm at a battlefield, your next card costs 2 energy and 2 runes of any type less.

Darius, Trifarian.tx: When you play your second card in a turn, give me +2 might this turn and ready me.

Vi, Peacekeeper.tx: [Ambush] (You may play me as a [Reaction] to a battlefield where you have units.) When I attack, [Stun] an enemy unit here. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)

Mischievous Marai.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) When you play me to a battlefield, deal 2 to an enemy unit here.

Sterak's Gage.tx: [Quick-Draw] (This has [Reaction]. When you play it, attach it to a unit you control.) [Equip] 1 calm rune (1 calm rune: Attach this to a unit you control.)

Ruined Rex.tx: [Deathknell][>] Deal 4 to an enemy unit. (When I die, get the effect.)

Akali, Deadly Weapon.tx: [Empower] 2 energy and 1 fury rune (2 energy and 1 fury rune: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.) When I move, you may deal 1 to a unit at a battlefield I moved to or from. If I'm [Empowered], deal 2 instead. [Empowered][>] I have +1 might.

Watchful Sentry.tx: [Deathknell] — Draw 1. (When I die, get the effect.)

Honest Broker.tx: [Deathknell] — Play a Gold gear token exhausted. (When I die, get the effect.)

Zhonya's Hourglass.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) The next time a friendly unit would die, kill this instead. Recall that unit exhausted. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)

Glasc Mixologist.tx: [Deathknell] — You may play a unit with cost no more than 3 energy and no more than 1 rune of any type from your trash, ignoring its cost. (When I die, get the effect.)

Defy.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Counter a spell that costs no more than 4 energy and no more than 1 rune of any type.

Soaring Scout.tx: [Deathknell] — Channel 1 rune exhausted. (When I die, get the effect.)

Deathgrip.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Kill a friendly unit to give +might equal to its Might to another friendly unit this turn. Draw 1.

Karthus, Eternal.tx: Your [Deathknell] effects trigger an additional time.

Hidden Blade.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Kill a unit at a battlefield. Its controller draws 2.

Ferrous Forerunner.tx: [Deathknell] — Play two 3 might Mech unit tokens to your base. (When I die, get the effect.)

Shuriken Flip.tx: Deal 2 to up to one enemy unit at a battlefield, then move a friendly unit. [Flow] 3 energy and 1 rune of any type (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)

Kai'Sa, Survivor.tx: [Accelerate] (You may pay 1 energy and 1 fury rune as an additional cost to have me enter ready.) When I conquer, draw 1.

Mirror Image.tx: Choose a unit. Play a ready Reflection unit token to your base. It becomes a copy of that unit. Give it [Temporary]. (Kill it at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)

Mournful Witness.tx: When a combat that I was in ends, empower me. (I become Empowered if I'm not already.) [Empowered][>] I have +2 might.

Sacrifice.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) As an additional cost to play this, kill a friendly [Mighty] unit. (A unit is Mighty while it has 5+ might.) Draw 2 and channel 1 rune exhausted.

Akali, Silent.tx: I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities unless I'm in combat. When I move to a battlefield, give me +2 might this turn.

Blitzcrank, Impassive.tx: [Tank] (I must be assigned combat damage first.) When you play me to a battlefield, you may move an enemy unit to here. When I hold, return me to my owner's hand.

Falling Star.tx: Deal 3 to a unit. Deal 3 to a unit.

Discipline.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Give a unit +2 might this turn. Draw 1.

Back Off.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) [Stun] a unit. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.) If you played this from your hand, draw 1.

LeBlanc, Deceiver.tx: When you conquer or hold, you may discard 1 and exhaust me to play a ready Reflection unit token there. It becomes a copy of another unit there. Give it [Temporary].

Not So Fast.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Counter an enemy spell or ability that chooses a friendly unit or gear.

Black Rose Dignitary.tx: [Assault] (+1 might while I'm an attacker.) [Deathknell][>] Channel 1 rune exhausted. (When I die, get the effect.)
